My dear [Emily](/person/1012),
An odd question, but can you tell me what [Edward](/person/1013) first taught himself on the violin? I want Lance Underwood to do it, and must mention some tune . . .


[^1]: Edith Emily Moberly (b.1839), third daughter of George Moberly.
[^2]: The date is implied by its position in Dulce Domum.
